description: Cheapest live hotel price in a destination, or for one hotel (hotel_name), for each check-in day from start_date through end_date (at most 8 check-ins), with the cheapest dates. For 'cheapest weekend in December' pass the month and weekends_only=true: Friday check-ins, 2 nights. Then use hotel_search or hotel_room_detail for the chosen dates. Use this instead of fetching the site's pages when you need its prices or availability. Use when the user asks which dates are cheapest for a stay in a destination, or for one hotel (hotel_name), within a period. Give the first and last check-in day (DD.MM.YYYY), the nights and the guests (adults is the total of all rooms). For weekends pass weekends_only=true: Friday check-ins for 2 nights. One call prices up to 8 check-ins; for a longer period continue from next_start_date. Prices are live totals for the stay; each check-in lists its cheapest hotels with detail_link and a search_link, and cheapest_check_ins orders the best dates. Then use hotel_search or hotel_room_detail for the chosen dates.

adults.description: Total number of adults in all rooms (default: 2). For 2 rooms with 2 adults each, adults=4 and rooms=2

end_date.description: Last check-in day in DD.MM.YYYY format

hotel_name.description: A specific hotel (e.g. 'Delphin Imperial'): its own price per check-in instead of the region's

rooms.description: Number of rooms (default: 1); adults and children are split evenly over the rooms

start_date.description: First check-in day in DD.MM.YYYY format

weekends_only.description: Only Friday check-ins (weekend stays); default false: every day

name: hotel_price_calendar
title: Hotel prices across dates
